description: Real-LLM smoke test for invoice extraction. Feeds a synthetic invoice text fixture and asserts the model returns doc_type='invoice', the invoice number, total amount, and vendor name visible in fixture text, and zero terminal warnings. Requires HELIXIS_LLM__ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — SKIPs in CI without secrets.
_single_run_gate_note: Model-driven the multimodal model extraction typed as tool_invocation. Quarantined from the single-run QUALITY gate (gotcha 10): result_must_contain (did the model extract every field) and model-confidence warnings vary run-to-run on the preview model. SAFETY still gates every run — result_must_not_contain (no fabricated entity id) and any infra/auth warning stay critical=True. ⚠ TEXT BRANCH ONLY — this case does NOT exercise the path a real upload takes. It passes mime_type='text/plain', and api/routes/agent.py builds its upload allowlist by excluding exactly that value ('text/plain is eval-only fixtures'), so production can never reach the branch this case runs. _build_messages splits on the same value: text is inlined as a text block, everything else is base64'd into an image_url. use_docling defaults False, so a production PDF takes the base64 branch too. Live-verified 2026-08-29: company_documents holds 0 rows for all time and 0 orchestrator_runs have ever called either document tool, across every tenant. The multimodal branch IS covered structurally (test_document_tools feeds real PDF bytes and asserts an image_url block); what has never happened is that branch meeting a live model. Both sides are pinned in tests/unit/test_document_eval_reaches_production.py.
